query: I just picked up a new lavender phone case on my way home earlier, it has little hand-embroidered cherry blossoms on the corners and it fits my phone perfectly, I even got a matching popsocket that has a tiny cat paw charm hanging off of it. I stopped by my favorite boba shop on the way back too, they had a new honey oolong milk tea with golden boba that I’d been wanting to try, and it was so good I already want to go back tomorrow to get another one. Oh also, I tried to turn my phone on a little while ago and it’s asking me for a SIM PIN that I can’t remember to unlock the card, and when I tried to use a friend’s phone to check what was going on I found out my line is suspended because I have an overdue bill and my contract just ended, can you help me sort this out?
